# game-icons.net glyphs (vendored)

Only the glyphs this game uses are copied here, unmodified, from
https://github.com/game-icons/icons (folder layout `<author>/<name>.svg`).

Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0),
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ — commercial use allowed with attribution.
See `license.txt` (the upstream notice) and `assets/icons/CREDITS.md` for per-glyph credits.

`tools/icons/generate_icon_packs.js` reads these files, recolours the glyph and adds our ink outline
and medallion; the build output is original composition around the credited glyphs.
